title: FAKE referral letter (gastroenterology)

pages.text:
SYNTHETIC / FAKE TEST DOCUMENT — NOT A REAL PATIENT — FOR SOFTWARE DEMONSTRATION ONLY
FAKE-send-delete Family Practice (FAKE)
100 Example Road, Suite 1, Testville ON  Z9Z 9Z9 · Tel 555-0100 · Fax 555-0101
October 16, 2026

Dr. Ian Sampleton
Gastroenterology Clinic, Lakeview Test General Hospital (FAKE)

Re: FAKE-NewWindows FAKE-WINDOWS-FIRST-DEVICE · DOB: 1 January 1990 · Health card: 9999996003 (FAKE)

Dear Dr. Sampleton,

Thank you for seeing FAKE-NewWindows, a 36-year-old software tester, for assessment of iron deficiency anemia with a positive celiac screen. Over the past four months they have had tiredness, bloating after meals and loose stools two to three times a day. They have lost 4 kg without trying. They have had no blood in the stool, no black stools, no vomiting and no night sweats.

Background
Iron deficiency first found in 2024, treated with oral iron; it has come back
Migraine without aura, about two a month
Mild asthma in childhood, no attacks as an adult
No operations
Mother has hypothyroidism; a cousin has celiac disease
Current medications
Ferrous fumarate 300 mg every other day, since August 2026
Sumatriptan 50 mg as needed for migraine
Salbutamol inhaler as needed (rarely used)

Allergies: none known.

Examination and investigations

BP 112/70, heart rate 84 and regular. Weight 58 kg, down from 62 kg in June 2026; BMI 20.1. Pale conjunctivae. Abdomen soft and mildly bloated, not tender, no masses.

Bloods (9 October 2026): hemoglobin 104 g/L with an MCV of 74 fL, ferritin 6 µg/L, tissue transglutaminase IgA 86 U/mL (normal below 15) with a normal total IgA, TSH 2.1 mU/L, vitamin B12 210 pmol/L (low normal).

Questions
Does FAKE-NewWindows need a gastroscopy with duodenal biopsies to confirm celiac disease?
Should they keep eating gluten until the biopsy, and for how long?
Would you recommend intravenous iron, since oral iron has not corrected the anemia?

I have asked them to keep eating gluten for now and not to start a gluten-free diet before your assessment. I would be grateful if they could be seen within the next 4 to 6 weeks.

Sincerely,

Dr. Henrietta Fakeham, MD (FAKE)
Family Physician, FAKE-send-delete Family Practice
